q.id: Tujuan utama CI/CD bagi QA:
q.en: The main purpose of CI/CD for QA:

id: Menjalankan build dan test otomatis pada setiap perubahan untuk feedback cepat
en: Run builds and tests automatically on every change for fast feedback
Remove the need for code review

exp.id: Contoh: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.
exp.en: Examples: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins.

q.id: Flaky test adalah test yang...
q.en: A flaky test is one that...

id: Kadang lolos kadang gagal tanpa perubahan kode
en: Sometimes passes and sometimes fails without code changes

exp.id: Penyebab: timing/wait buruk, data bersama, ketergantungan antar test, lingkungan tidak stabil.
exp.en: Causes: poor timing/waits, shared data, test inter-dependence, unstable environments.

q.id: Apa penyebab umum flaky test dan cara mengatasinya?
q.en: What are common causes of flaky tests and how do you fix them?

model.id: Penyebab: sinkronisasi/wait buruk, data test bersama atau tidak terisolasi, lingkungan/dependensi eksternal tidak stabil. Solusi: explicit wait, data terisolasi, mock dependensi, stabilkan environment.
model.en: Causes: poor synchronisation/waits, shared or non-isolated test data, unstable environment/external dependencies. Fixes: explicit waits, isolated data, mock dependencies, stabilise environment.

exp.en: @BeforeClass once per class, @BeforeSuite once per suite.

q.id: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) adalah...
q.en: Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) is...

id: Penyisipan script berbahaya yang dieksekusi di browser korban
en: Injection of malicious script executed in a victim's browser
An attack on the database only

exp.id: Mitigasi: output encoding, validasi input, Content Security Policy.

q.id: Tujuan mock atau stub dalam testing:

id: Menggantikan dependensi eksternal agar test terisolasi dan deterministik
en: Replace external dependencies so tests are isolated and deterministic

exp.id: Contoh: WireMock, Mockito, MSW.
exp.en: Examples: WireMock, Mockito, MSW.

q.id: Kapan sebaiknya sebuah test TIDAK diotomasi?
q.en: When should a test NOT be automated?

model.id: Jika hanya dijalankan sekali/jarang, fiturnya sering berubah (tidak stabil), atau butuh penilaian manusia seperti exploratory dan usability.
model.en: If it runs once or rarely, the feature changes often (unstable), or it needs human judgement such as exploratory and usability testing.

q.id: Otomasi paling menguntungkan (ROI tinggi) untuk...
q.en: Automation has the highest ROI for...

id: Regression test yang berulang dan stabil

exp.id: Semakin sering dijalankan dan semakin stabil, semakin cepat biaya otomasi terbayar.
exp.en: The more often it runs and the more stable it is, the sooner automation pays off.

model.en: Requirement analysis, test planning, test case design, environment setup, test execution, and test closure.

q.id: Perbedaan test case dan test scenario:
q.en: Difference between a test case and a test scenario:

id: Scenario: gambaran tinggi apa yang diuji; test case: langkah, data, dan expected result detail
Test case lebih umum daripada scenario
en: Scenario: high-level what to test; test case: detailed steps, data, and expected result
A test case is more general than a scenario

exp.id: Satu scenario bisa menghasilkan banyak test case (positif dan negatif).
exp.en: One scenario can yield many test cases (positive and negative).

q.id: Bagaimana Anda memprioritaskan test saat waktu sangat terbatas?
q.en: How do you prioritise tests when time is very limited?

model.id: Berbasis risiko: utamakan fitur kritis bisnis, area dengan perubahan terbaru, dan area yang sering bermasalah; jalankan smoke dan regression inti dulu.
model.en: Risk-based: prioritise business-critical features, recently changed areas, and historically defect-prone areas; run smoke and core regression first.
